summary: Accept optional leading actor attribution on operational inspection reads

replay.detail: Read subjects, filters and result data are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The documented operational read leaves accept optional --as immediately after their command path. Explicit actors produce a stderr attribution record without changing stdout or daemon authorization. Agent callers cannot attribute a read to another identity, including on offline leaves.

downtime.detail: No daemon upgrade or restart is required.

manual.detail: Actorless reads retain their existing behavior. The generated actor contract describes the new optional syntax.

recovery.detail: No persistent state is changed by attribution.
